scale: Approx. 1:250,000 regionally; mixed source resolution, generalized shorelines
dateRange: Mixed source dates. No per-feature shoreline observation date established. v1.0 published 2016; mirror release 2024.4 is not an observation date.
processing: Select entire source polygons intersecting the local navigation window using GDAL; retain original geometry; WGS84 GeoJSON export. No clipping, buffer, manual bank editing or shoreline year assignment.

features.temporal: undated inventory context; not a yearly observation

limitations: Inventory mapping, not measured current water, historic pre-dam water or a dated operational shoreline. Small islands may be removed by upstream compilation. No area-difference or temporal animation is inferred from this layer.
independentIntegrityCheck: Matches the public Git LFS pointer for the same original HydroLAKES shapefile from waterfolk/Hydrolakes_polygons.
